name: Hair lifts and settles
text: Her hair lifts and falls back against her shoulder.
desc: Wind in the hair, subject otherwise held - on a wide. On a close shot the model lands it by putting her own hands in her hair instead, which is a different beat and occupies the hands.
needs: a person with loose hair in frame

measured.staging_note: subject_scale is the fraction of the frame the subject's coat occupies in that staging's keyframe - the run's measure of how close the subject is staged.

verdict: RE-MEASURED ACROSS FOUR STAGINGS 2026-08-04, 3 seeds each, watched at 7702. The hair does lift at all four - f84 at `far`, f60 at `mid`, f36 at `close`, f36 at `anchor` - but WHAT LIFTS IT CHANGES WITH THE STAGING. At the two wide stagings it is wind, subject otherwise held, which is what the card promises. At `close` and `anchor` she puts her own hands into her hair instead, which is a different beat and occupies the hands. 0.573 / 0.461 / 1.916 / 0.745.
